rsqrt_contract.source_diagnosis: Both old reference and c12 rsqrt assign fault=OR of13 intermediate-stage arithmetic fault events. These are not delayed to corresponding output transaction; stage latency changes move fault events across cycles. Existing test aligns overallresult latency and separately counts faults; this is not a result-aligned fault proof. c12 side ORs faults regardless output valid and lane registers aggregate fault. DDIV does not enter rsqrt cone.
